newsitem.title: USA: Florida puts $13.6 mln revenue bond sale on notice.
newsitem.headline: Florida puts $13.6 mln revenue bond sale on notice.

text.p: Florida will sell $13.6 million of revenue bonds by competitive bid with 20 hours notice, the state Division of Bond Finance said.
The issue is Florida Department of Management Services Division of Facilities Management, Florida Facilities Pool Revenue Bonds, Series 1997A.
Maturities range out to 2026. Proceeds will finance the purchase of an office building in Tallahassee for the state Department of Environmental Protection.
